mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 850,000 units over the past 2 months signals a contraction in residential investment, which reduces demand for construction materials and consumer durables, leading to lower inflation expectations and a higher probability of monetary easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST < 850.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.5 index points over the past 3 months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces input costs and inflationary pressure, increasing the likelihood of future monetary easing and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO < 100.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in private demand, which increases the probability of central bank intervention via rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST < 850.0 and RSAFS < 425000.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% over the past 3 months signals a tightening cycle, which increases discount rates on equity cash flows and reduces valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 6.5% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 137,000 thousand signals a labor market weakening that increases the probability of monetary easing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both UNRATE > 6.5 and PAYEMS < 137000.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 425,000 million dollars over the past 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and increases the likelihood of future rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS < 425000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
